units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:1:2">Y. Kil. IV, beg. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>והוא שבא ממַטַּע כרם גדול</he> provided it was originally a large vine plantation.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25:3">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <he>לא תתעסקו אלא במ׳ תחלה</he> as the first thing be engaged in nothing but planting; a. e.
